>
[Floating Shield](/Equipment.aspx?ID=319)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 587 <sup>4.0</sup>

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** strapped to 1 hand

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Base Shield** [Buckler](/Shields.aspx?ID=1)
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

A _floating shield_ is usually carved with wing motifs. This [buckler](/Shields.aspx?ID=1) (Hardness 6, HP 24, BT 12) can protect you on its own.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> Interact;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** The shield magically releases itself and floats off your arm into the air next to you, granting you its bonus automatically, as if you had [Raised the Shield](/Actions.aspx?ID=98). Because you’re not wielding the shield, you can’t use reactions such as [Shield Block](/Feats.aspx?ID=839) with the shield, but you gain its benefits even when using both of your hands. After 1 minute, the shield drops to the ground, ending its floating effect. While the shield is adjacent to you, you can Interact to grasp it, ending its floating effect early.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>
